Concluding the last flight of any Space Shuttle on Runway 15 at NASA's Kennedy Space Center, the orbiter's wheels stopped at 5:57:54 a.m. EDT / 9:57:54 UTC.Mission Commander Chris Ferguson remarked: "Mission complete, Houston, After serving the world for over 30 years, the shuttle has earned its place in history, and it has come to a final stop...Thank you, Columbia, Challenger, Discovery, Endeavour, and our ship, Atlantis.
